title: stochbench: a benchmark set of stochastic models for testing fitting algorithms and simulators
description: A benchmark collection of stochastic parameter-recovery problems. Each problem is a published stochastic model written in the BioNetGen language (BNGL), a set of chosen true parameter values, data simulated from them, search bounds, and a simulation budget. A fitting method is scored on whether it recovers the true values from the data within the budget; the right answer is known exactly, because it was chosen. The scoring protocol, the problem-definition format and the versioning rule are in PROTOCOL.md.
